## About
Deep Stack Poker & Card Room is a poker room on Fishinger Blvd in Hilliard. Come in when you want to scratch the itch for some cards, sit down with friendly players, and enjoy a game that keeps moving.
We are open every day of the week and stay open late, so there is room for a game after work or well into the night. Players have told us they appreciate a well run tournament, comfy chairs and TVs placed where you can see them.

## Services
- Tournaments: Sit in on a tournament with friendly players and a good game pace. One player joined us for a Wednesday evening tournament and plans to come back.

## FAQ
Q: What are your Friday hours?
A: On Friday we open at 5:00 PM and run until 5:00 AM.

Q: Where in Hilliard are you?
A: You will find us at 3814 Fishinger Blvd in Hilliard.

## What customers say
- "Ok so here’s my honest opinion. The club is the most professional and polite place I’ve ever played poker. The cleanliness makes for an enjoyable time, the TVs are well placed and the chairs are comfy (that’s more important than people think) The dealers are friendly and professional as well. The boys need a little practice and focus, but that comes with time when pitching cards. The others were just fine. Jason was top notch at the casino and is there as well. The 500 max in my opinion is a little much for a 1/2 and can play like a 2/5. Which I don’t mind. Overall It’s a great establishment for just being open a few months. Just need to get more clientele but with the way they operate that won’t be a problem." (Big George, 5/5)
- "Wanted to scratch the itch for some poker. Came in for a Wednesday evening tournament and the crew there was great, greeted me right away. The other players were friendly and the game pace was great. Definitely will be back for another tournament and hopefully next time the cards will be as friendly as the people!" (Lucas Roland, 5/5)
- "Great place! Tournament was well run. Staff is super friendly! This place is worth checking out!" (Jason Baker, 5/5)
- "Great staff and a great time! Super professional:)" (Ariss, 5/5)
